The 10th symbol, `nmp_app_set_lifecycle_callback`, was **not** migrated. The runtime's lifecycle observer slot (`Arc<Mutex<Option<LifecycleObserverRegistration>>>` in `nmp-core/src/actor/commands/lifecycle.rs`) uses a snapshot-then-call pattern: the actor copies the registration under the lock, releases the mutex, then invokes the callback. There is **no `in_flight` counter + `Condvar` drain gate** like `UpdateListenerGate`/`CapabilityCallbackGate` have. So `set_lifecycle_observer(None)` can return while the actor is past the snapshot and about to call the old closure — wrapping a UniFFI foreign ARC there is a use-after-free. This is the **same structural gap as the C4 `ActionRegistry` case (#2429)**. Per spec I flagged it rather than inventing an unsafe teardown; documented in `runtime/mod.rs`. A drain gate must be added to `LifecycleObserverSlot` in nmp-core before this interface can be exposed. (Consequently there is no lifecycle-callback teardown test, because no callback interface is exposed.) [...] ## The two drain gates added
1. **`LifecycleObserverGate`** (`crates/nmp-core/src/actor/commands/lifecycle.rs`) — replaced `Arc<Mutex<Option<LifecycleObserverRegistration>>>` (snapshot-then-call, no drain) with an `in_flight` counter + `Condvar`, copied exactly from `CapabilityCallbackGate`. Two registration paths share it last-writer-wins: C-ABI `LifecycleObserverRegistration` and the new Rust-native `NativeLifecycleObserver`. `set_registration`/`set_native_observer`/`clear` drain in-flight before returning. The invocation uses an RAII guard so `in_flight` balances even on panic.
2. **`ResultObserverGate`** (`crates/nmp-core/src/kernel/action_registry/result_observer_gate.rs`) — `ActionRegistry`'s result observer moved off the lock-across-the-call mutex. `deliver_result` now snapshots + increments under the lock then invokes with **no lock held**; added `clear_result_observer` + `has_result_observer` with drain-before-return. [...] 2. **`ResultObserverGate`** (`crates/nmp-core/src/kernel/action_registry/result_observer_gate.rs`) — `ActionRegistry`'s result observer moved off the lock-across-the-call mutex. `deliver_result` now snapshots + increments under the lock then invokes with **no lock held**; added `clear_result_observer` + `has_result_observer` with drain-before-return. [...] `NmpApp::drop` (native-runtime) now drains the lifecycle gate before joining the actor. [...] New UniFFI `#[uniffi::export(callback_interface)] trait LifecycleSink { fn on_lifecycle_transition(&self, phase: u32); }` + `NmpApp::set_lifecycle_sink(Option<Box<dyn LifecycleSink>>)` in `crates/nmp-uniffi/src/runtime/`, routed through the gate (copy phase before the foreign call, no wrapper lock across it, reentrancy forbidden, panic-contained). C-ABI `nmp_app_set_lifecycle_callback` left additive. Also added `clear_action_result_observer` to backfill the C4 teardown. [...] Assistant: C-tail executed in full this time — **PR #2440**: both drain gates added (`LifecycleObserverGate` + `ResultObserverGate`, copied from `CapabilityCallbackGate`), `set_lifecycle_callback` migrated, C4 teardown backfilled, and crucially **regression-proven** (broke `wait_drained`, confirmed 6 tests fail, reverted). All scoped suites green, drift OK, **#2429 closed**.
